title: NIM Service Mesh
description: Trace-derived traffic between NIM services. Edges represent observed operations, not network-level connections. Metrics begin when Alloy receives correlated spans; idle services may not appear. Connections are colored by transport: NATS blue, HTTP orange, Unknown/other gray.

panels.title: Service traffic flow
panels.description: Trace-derived service connections. Blue: NATS. Orange: HTTP. Gray: Unknown/other. Hover or click an edge for transport and request rate. Separate transports between the same services have distinct edges.
